questions.question: What is the main goal of pre-training a large language model?
options: To specialize the model for a specific company task
To teach the model general language patterns by predicting the next word
To permanently reduce the number of parameters
To generate images from text prompts

questions.question: In the chapter analogy, a pre-trained model is compared to:
options: A high school student learning grammar
A super-smart college graduate with general knowledge
A robot designed for a single job

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of fine-tuning an AI model?
options: To specialize the model for a particular task or style
To reduce the training dataset size

questions.question: Which example best represents a fine-tuning task?
options: Teaching a model basic English grammar
Training a model specifically to write Gen Z marketing emails
Reducing the number of tokens in a prompt

questions.question: What type of dataset is required for supervised fine-tuning (SFT)?
options: A dataset of unlabeled random text
A dataset of input and perfect output pairs

questions.question: In supervised fine-tuning, who acts as the supervisor determining correct answers?
What internal components of the model are adjusted during fine-tuning?
options: The parameters such as weights and biases

questions.question: What does SFT stand for?
Why might supervised fine-tuning alone not be enough for a safe AI system?
options: Because it removes the ability to generate text
Because it does not directly enforce helpfulness, safety, or alignment

questions.question: What does RLHF stand for?
RLHF helps make AI models:
options: More helpful, safe, and aligned with human preferences

questions.question: In the RLHF process, what happens first?
options: The model generates multiple candidate responses

questions.question: During the human ranking step of RLHF, what do human reviewers do?
options: Rank the AI responses from best to worst

questions.question: What criteria might humans use when ranking responses in RLHF?
What role does the reward model play in RLHF?
options: It assigns scores based on human preferences

questions.question: Why is RLHF compared to training a puppy with treats?
options: Because the AI receives rewards for good behavior and penalties for bad responses
Because the model uses animal datasets
Because reinforcement learning removes neural networks

questions.question: What happens when the model produces a polite and helpful response during RLHF?
options: It receives a high reward score

questions.question: What happens when the model produces a rude or dangerous response during RLHF?
What is the main objective of reinforcement learning in RLHF?
options: To maximize the reward score learned from human feedback
To reduce the size of the training dataset

questions.question: Which real-world AI system was improved using RLHF to become more helpful and polite?
